_comment: Generated by tools/gen_map.py -- DO NOT HAND-EDIT. Rerun `python tools/gen_map.py <octave_span_mm>` and copy its printed values, or the map in data/ and this overlay will silently disagree. These are the only settings that differ from a stock Piano-LED-Visualizer install (decision D-08).
_strip_origin: +1.003 mm from A0's left edge -- the tape centred on the playing width (1.00 mm of margin at each end), decided 2026-09-21 so the bar is symmetric on the keyboard. The previous min-error origin was -7.75 mm, which left 9.76 mm bare at the top end; centring costs 0.05 mm of worst-case centre error (3.40 -> 3.45 mm) and keeps 88/88 unique LEDs.
_measured: M1 = 164.8 mm octave span, from Kevin's 5-octave reading of 82.4 cm on 2026-09-15 (single measurement)

_upstream_defaults_for_contrast._why_they_are_wrong: a uniform 13.889 mm/note; drifts up to 8.89 mm and asks for LED 176 on a 176-LED strip for C8
